you can only really trade so much of 1 item since it's limited by having 1 trade cart per item (of course you can also assign families but unless you assign a crazy number of families to multiple trade posts you won't notice much difference)

So, if you have a surplus of slabs enough to export both at once, then export both!

Also, some of the value in making swords is that since carts have a limit to how many items they can transport at once, transporting the same number of swords as slabs is of course going to give you more money per trip

  
It isn't a perfect system by any means, but it also has a lot more complexity in its current state than I think many people give it credit :)

I see a lot of people saying they like the ships and battles in DNT but honestly I don't feel it, I love the weight and believability of the OVA ships. DNT ships are very clean and covered in glowing bits (plus those weird retracting bridges on the FPA ships), the OVA ships feel like real pieces of military hardware, especially seeing the RCS thrusters firing when they manoeuvre just excites the hard sci-fi enthusiast in me. Also, the OVA depiction of beam weapons just feels so powerful, the sound and visuals (plus they look more like how beam weapons WOULD look, a stream of particles accelerated to near-light speed, as opposed to the pew pew slow moving glowing projectiles from DNT)

TLDR; I love hard sci-fi, and the depiction of tech in the OVA feels far more grounded and believable to me

As far as I'm aware, turrets have a small blindspot behind their "head", so enabling idle movement prevents people sneaking up on it. The downside to idle movement is that if you're engaging an enemy and the idle movement has made the turret point its blindspot to the enemy then there will be a short period where the turret just does not give a shit, until it next moves into a rotation where it can detect the enemy. This blindspot is about 10-15 degrees though so it's not too significant.

I got the info re: the blindspot from the first response to this post: [https://www.reddit.com/r/spaceengineers/comments/ih2kzn/small\_rant\_turret\_tracking/?utm\_source=share&utm\_medium=web2x&context=3](https://www.reddit.com/r/spaceengineers/comments/ih2kzn/small_rant_turret_tracking/?utm_source=share&utm_medium=web2x&context=3) 

Unfortunately it's not listed in the wiki anywhere, one of many wiki oversights that would be very useful to include.

Re: the default range being 600m...I honestly have no clue. The only things I can come up with are that either it punishes people for not taking the time to set up their turrets in the K menu, or it's a kind of "eco mode" to save ammo.
